voice_hotkey_name_runtime_toggle: Start / Stop local speech recognition hotkey
voice_capture_busy: Already setting a hotkey. Finish it first or press Esc to cancel.
voice_hotkeys_channel_cycle_desc: In games with multiple chat channels (like Team / All in League of Legends), cycles through the channels in order. The input bar shows the current channel.
voice_hotkeys_resend_last_desc: Resends your last successfully sent message to the current window (does nothing while you're speaking).
voice_hotkeys_post_process_toggle_desc: Quickly turn text processing on or off, starting with your next line. The input bar briefly shows the new state.
voice_hotkeys_post_process_cycle_desc: Switches to the next text processing pipeline. Does nothing if you only have one.
voice_hotkeys_section_desc: Press a key combo to set it. Leave it empty to turn it off, so it never triggers by accident.
voice_hotkey_pending_local: Takes effect once local speech recognition is started.
voice_hotkey_pending_ready: Takes effect once speech recognition is ready.
voice_hotkey_status_unknown: Can't confirm whether the hotkey is registered
voice_hotkey_saved_unconfirmed: {title} saved. Can't confirm yet whether it's active.
voice_hotkey_empty: {title} can't be empty. To turn it off, click Clear.
voice_hotkey_capturing: Press a key combo or mouse side button… (Esc to cancel)
voice_hotkey_hint: Type a hotkey and press Enter to save, or click to set it with a key combo / mouse side button.
voice_hotkey_unset_long: Not set (off by default, never triggers by accident)
voice_asr_not_downloaded: {name} isn't downloaded yet. Download it under Switch model below.
voice_asr_toggle_hotkey_desc: Start or stop local speech recognition, even from inside a game. Works even when it isn't started.
voice_asr_autostart_desc: Loads the local recognition model automatically, so you don't have to click Start every time.
voice_asr_autostart_on: Local recognition will start automatically when Kotone opens
voice_asr_online_needs_key: Online recognition (DeepSeek): needs a DeepSeek API key →
voice_overlay_assistant_listening: Listening · Submits when you finish (press {hotkey} again to submit now)
voice_overlay_idle_capsule: Kotone standing by · Press the hotkey to talk
voice_overlay_needs_elevation: The target app has higher privileges. Run Kotone as administrator and try again.
voice_overlay_idle_hint: Standing by · Press the hotkey to start talking
voice_mode_ptt_desc: Hold to talk, release to send
voice_mode_dictation_desc: Press to start, press again to stop
voice_mode_one_shot_desc: Stops and sends automatically when you finish
voice_mode_solo_desc: Keeps listening and sends each line; press again to stop
voice_general_elevation_title: The game runs as administrator, and Kotone doesn't
voice_general_elevation_desc: While the game is in front, the call key and hotkeys don't reach Kotone, and typing into the game is blocked. Restart Kotone as administrator; your other settings stay.
voice_general_fullscreen_title: The game is running in fullscreen mode
voice_general_fullscreen_desc: In fullscreen, bringing up the input bar may minimize the game. Switch to borderless or windowed mode in the game's video settings.
voice_general_hotkey_desc: Press it to talk, and your exact words are typed into the game's chat box. Works with key combos and the Mouse4 / Mouse5 side buttons.
voice_general_hotkey_register_failed: Couldn't register the hotkey. Another app or another Kotone instance may be using it.
voice_general_mode_desc: How it records after you press the hotkey, and when it sends.
voice_general_mode_legacy: Currently in compatibility mode (based on the old hotkey trigger and send behavior settings). Pick a card above to switch to a preset mode.
voice_general_vad_desc_solo: When the silence between lines lasts this long, the line is cut off and sent, then it keeps listening for the next one (200–5000 ms, requires the VAD model to be ready).
voice_general_vad_desc: When you stop talking and the silence lasts this long, it stops and sends automatically (200–5000 ms, requires the VAD model to be ready).
voice_general_overlay_desc: A small bar in the game that shows recognition progress during voice input. Your character's replies appear in the floating window, not here.
voice_overlay_visibility_on_demand_desc: Hidden normally, appears when you talk, hides after sending
voice_overlay_visibility_always_desc: Always shown on top of the game
voice_overlay_visibility_never_desc: Turns off the input bar; hotkeys and voice input still work
voice_general_overlay_position_custom: Using the position you last dragged it to.
voice_general_overlay_mouse_label: Allow clicking and dragging the input bar
voice_general_overlay_mouse_desc: When on, you can drag it and click its buttons. When off, its position is locked and clicks pass through to the game.
voice_general_overlay_mouse_on: Input bar can now be clicked and dragged
voice_general_overlay_mouse_off: Input bar locked; clicks now pass through to the game
voice_overlay_style_capsule_desc: Smaller, covers less of the screen
voice_overlay_style_card_desc: Shows everything, good for first-time use
voice_general_guide_reopen: Run the voice input setup again
voice_guide_mode_dictation_desc: Press to start, press again to stop, confirm to send
voice_guide_mode_one_shot_desc: Press once; sends automatically when you finish
voice_guide_dir_migrate_partial: Folder changed, but {count} item(s) couldn't be moved (download them again)
voice_guide_download_cancelled: Download canceled. You can resume anytime.
voice_guide_model_incomplete: No complete model found yet. Check the file names and folder, then try again.
voice_guide_hotkey_conflict: The voice input hotkey is the same as {conflict}. Choose another one.
voice_guide_title: Set up voice input in four steps
voice_guide_profile_title: Which game will you use it in?
voice_guide_profile_desc: Sets the chat key, input method, and game term list. It doesn't limit which window you can send to.
voice_guide_online_now: Using {name} now: ready whenever Kotone is open, no need to start it.
voice_guide_local_title: {name}: free, no internet needed, text appears as you speak
voice_guide_model_line: {model} · Download once; your voice is never uploaded
voice_guide_dir_error: {error}. The model path must use only English characters, e.g. {example}.
voice_guide_input_blocked_desc: Add Kotone to the trusted list of your security software (such as 360 or Huorong), then check again. {detail}
voice_guide_try_after: and say something, like “Jungle come bot”. In a game, your words get typed into the chat box just like this.
voice_guide_try_done: ✓ It works! Voice input is all set.
voice_history_audio_empty: The audio file is empty or was cleaned up
voice_history_audio_on: Saving audio with history is on
voice_history_audio_off: Saving audio with history is off (existing audio is kept)
voice_history_page_desc: Every line you've said with voice input is logged here, stored only on this PC. Your conversations with your character are in the conversation list in the sidebar.
voice_history_mode_desc: How many voice input entries to keep.
voice_history_audio_desc: Saves a separate WAV for each new entry so you can play it back on this page. Uses more disk space.
voice_history_empty_desc: Your voice input history will show up here
voice_processing_sample_input: That dumbass enemy jungler is damn good
voice_processing_added_needs_config: Added: {name}. Fill in the required settings.
voice_processing_step_needs_config: Fill in this step's required settings first
voice_processing_blocklist_exported_buil: Exported the built-in blocked words list
voice_processing_blocklist_export_failed: Couldn't export the blocked words list: {error}
voice_processing_page_desc: After recognition, text is processed before it's sent to the game: blocked words, AI polish, translation… Steps run from top to bottom.
voice_processing_enable_on_desc: Takes effect from your next line
voice_processing_enable_off_desc: When off, recognized text is sent as is
voice_processing_current_desc: Only this one is used when you talk. The default blocked words work out of the box.
voice_processing_steps_empty_desc: Once you add a step, recognized text goes through this pipeline before it's sent.
voice_processing_module_missing_desc: This step's module isn't registered. You'll get a clear message when it runs.
voice_processing_field_file_placeholder: Choose or enter the path for {name}
voice_processing_no_connections: No connections available yet. Use the button on the right to add an API key.
voice_processing_blocklist_hint: Want to change the words? Export the default list as a template, edit it, then choose it here.
voice_processing_config_incomplete: This step turns on automatically once the required settings are filled in.
voice_processing_on_error_best_effort: Continue with the previous step's result
voice_processing_on_error_best_effort_sa: Will continue with the previous step's result on failure
voice_processing_add_step_desc: Click a row to add it to the current pipeline.
voice_processing_manage_desc: Create, rename, or delete pipelines. To switch, go back and use the dropdown.
voice_processing_tryout_desc: Enter some test text to see what text processing does. Nothing is sent to the game.
voice_processing_tryout_input_placeholde: Enter text to test the pipeline
